title: The Fixed Script
body:
# The script has finally been fixed!

Have _you_ ever played "The Broken Script" and wished it wasn't so broken?
Well, have I got the mod for you!

We have ~~kidnapped~~ recruited a couple of developers and ~~locked them in our basement~~ are paying them a ~~fair~~ wage until they finally develop a fixed version of the script. (HINT: That's not gonna happen!)

This mod adds:
- Null bossfight
- Integrity children
- Many random events
- Hoe of doom
- Absolutely nothing in the files!
- And much more!

**WARNING! MANY FEATURES WILL BREAK DURING MULITPLAYER, SO ONLY PLAY MULTIPLAYER WITH COMMANDS.**
